svg.title: Loup-Garou — Blood and Moon. Draft 1 / Loup-Garou classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Scent of Blood forks into Rending Claws then Killing Bite, or Run to Ground then The Pack Closes. Hunter's Moon forks into Feral Frenzy then Beast Unchained. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Loup-Garou jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

The bloodline is Taijutsu with a 15% Taijutsu Increase Damage Given passive, so the self buff is the lever that scales every element-less or Taijutsu hit the wolf lands in its window and is primary. Exposure is the other 2-round window and the one damage row is a single hit every 6 rounds, so they share second place; Heal is held at the +5 guardrail (+50 HP per tick) as tertiary. Scent of Blood is the only possible fourth purchase (37% exposure, 41 damage); the build has no second route.","cost":4,"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":5},"finals":[{"jutsu":"Nature's Hunter","row":0,"tag":"damage","label":"Damage","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"DAMAGE","adverse":false,"base":40.0,"gain":1,"final":41.0,"calculation":"formula","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Nature's Hunter","row":1,"tag":"increasedamagegiven","label":"Increase Damage Given","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"self","role":"SELF BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":8,"final":43.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Nature's Hunter","row":2,"tag":"heal","label":"Heal","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"self","role":"SELF BUFF","adverse":false,"base":25.0,"gain":5,"final":30.0,"calculation":"static","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Summon Wolf Companion","row":0,"tag":"summon","label":"summon","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"ENEMY BUFF","adverse":true,"base":75.0,"gain":0,"final":75.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Life reaver","row":0,"tag":"increasedamagetaken","label":"Increase Damage Taken","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"ENEMY DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":2,"final":37.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Life reaver","row":1,"tag":"absorb","label":"absorb","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"self","role":"SELF BUFF","adverse":false,"base":30.0,"gain":0,"final":30.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Beast Unchained"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on four rows, one row each (Damage, Increase Damage Given and Heal on Nature's Hunter; Increase Damage Taken on Life reaver); the Wolf Companion summon and Life reaver's absorb are unsupported. The enemy-facing root (Scent of Blood) forks into a damage route and an exposure route; the self-facing root (Hunter's Moon) is a single Foundation \u2192 Hidden \u2192 Advanced chain because its two rows share one cast and Heal is exhausted at +5 (the guardrail) after two purchases, so a second sustain Hidden Art or capstone would have to breach it or carry only Increase Damage Given, which would duplicate Feral Frenzy and open a second path to the IDG maximum. A damage or exposure branch under Hunter's Moon is structurally legal but would twin Rending Claws or Run to Ground on the same single rows, so it is declined. Three distinct complete builds (Burst, Exposure, Frenzy) exist; Burst and Exposure each have two fourth-purchase choices, Frenzy's fourth purchase is always Scent of Blood. 8 legal full-budget allocations, every node in a non-dominated one.","design_notes":["Node split: the roots mirror the kit's two faces. Scent of Blood (enemy-facing) raises Life reaver's exposure and Nature's Hunter's hit, then forks into Rending Claws \u2192 Killing Bite (damage) and Run to Ground \u2192 The Pack Closes (exposure). Hunter's Moon (self-facing) raises both of Nature's Hunter's self rows and runs one chain through Feral Frenzy \u2192 Beast Unchained. 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 BP (shared root) or 6 BP.","Damage and IDT flats: Damage reaches one 40-power row, so the route is 1+2+3 = +6 (the guardrail; Dai Kenja's single damage row uses the same total) and the Foundation's +1 is the sliver that keeps the Taiyo +2/+3 Hidden/Advanced shape. Increase Damage Taken is a single row but broad exposure, so it is held to Taiyo Kami's +7 IDT ceiling (2+3+2, 35\u219242%): the Hidden Art at the single-row +3, the capstone's +2 IDT paired with +3 IDG as in Taiyo's Eternal Noon.","IDG and Heal flats: Increase Damage Given is single-row and the bloodline's theme stat (15% Taijutsu passive), so the Frenzy chain carries 2+3+3 = +8 (35\u219243%), below the +10 guardrail that Dai Kenja's single IDG row uses, with +3 on The Pack Closes as that route's secondary (maximum 5 there with Hunter's Moon). Heal is single-row raw power at the +5 guardrail (2 on the Foundation, 3 on the capstone): 25\u219230 power, 250\u2192300 HP per tick, so the self chain cannot be deeper than three nodes.","Main tree and passives: the 15% Taijutsu IDG passive and Nature's Hunter's own buff each add percentage points of the staged base to a qualifying hit, so +6 power on the 40 row is worth more than +6 after them. The self buff (statTypes Taijutsu, no element) multiplies every element-less damage effect of any stat type the caster deals in its 2 rounds (basic attacks, weapons, non-elemental jutsu) plus Taijutsu elemental hits; not other elemental hits or pierce. Life reaver's exposure filters alike","Delivery and uptime: both carriers are single-target, range 4, cooldown 6, 350 chakra and 350 stamina. Nature's Hunter costs 60 AP and Life reaver 40 AP, so both fit one round, but whether a same-round buff or debuff already applies to that round's hits was not verified; windows are 2 following rounds. One cast per 6 rounds means at most 2 of 6 rounds carry the buff, heal ticks or exposure. Heal is static \u00d710 (250 HP per tick); the 10% Increase Heal passive adjusts heal_hp: ~275 now, 330 at +5","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) takes Hunter's Moon for a rounded cast (37% buff, 270 HP ticks) or Run to Ground for 40% exposure and no sustain. Exposure (01,04,05) takes Hunter's Moon (buff 40%, heal 270) or Rending Claws (damage 43). Frenzy (06,07,08) can only add Scent of Blood. The hybrids 01,02,04,06 and 01,02,06,07 are legal and non-dominated; 01,04,06,07 is dominated by The Pack Closes build, as expected when a hybrid skips its capstone. Nothing changes AP, cooldown or the summon."],"risks":["Classification: every supported row is element-less, so no existing element isolates this kit. Under the current resolver these rows are reachable only with affectedElements including None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. The tree assumes the proposed bloodline-keyed classification extension (label Loup-Garou). Normal-jutsu collision is unverified.","Broad self amplification: Beast Unchained puts Nature's Hunter's Increase Damage Given at 43% for 2 rounds; that percentage multiplies every element-less or Taijutsu non-pierce hit the caster lands in the window from any source (basic attacks, weapons, normal jutsu), not only the kit. BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is on at the pin, so it stacks with the 15% Taijutsu passive and other IDG sources.","Broad enemy exposure: The Pack Closes puts Life reaver's Increase Damage Taken at 42% for 2 rounds on one target; the added points amplify every qualifying hit from the kit, normal jutsu, weapons and allies (element-less hits of any stat type, Taijutsu elemental hits, pierce excluded). It stacks with other exposure on that target. One cast per 6 rounds limits self-stacking.","Value decision (user-owned): IDG route maximum is +8, not the +10 guardrail Dai Kenja's single IDG row uses, so the self-facing capstone does not out-bid the exposure capstone on the theme stat; +10 (Feral Frenzy +3, Beast Unchained +5) stays inside the guardrail if a stronger Frenzy route is preferred. IDT is held at Taiyo Kami's +7; +8 (Run to Ground +3, The Pack Closes +3) is the alternative.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling on Taijutsu / Speed, Strength) and then multiplied by the Taijutsu IDG passive and any active buff or exposure, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6 damage. The damage route is one hit every 6 rounds, so Killing Bite is the weakest capstone in reach (6 raw on 1 row) and is kept only because the kit has no other burst lever.","Heal timing and ticks: Nature's Hunter's Heal has rounds 2, so by the heal handler it applies on following rounds, read here as two ticks of power \u00d710 HP; the tick count and whether the 10% Increase Heal passive adjusts each tick were not simulated. Heal is a self row on an OTHER_USER jutsu, so it needs a legal enemy target to be cast.","Unsupported rows: the Wolf Companion summon (75% at level 25, marked adverse in the dossier as an enemy-side summon row) and Life reaver's 30% absorb receive nothing. No ally-hazard, hidden, item-gated or mode-restricted rows exist in this kit. No combat simulation was performed."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":7,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":7,"heal":5},"supported_rows_in_kit":4,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":1,"heal":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","heal","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Loup-Garou classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Loup-Garou jutsu inherit Loup-Garou potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":3,"increasedamagetaken":7}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":5}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Loup-Garou classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Loup-Garou jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
The Pack Closes path + Hunter's Moon
Beast Unchained path + Scent of Blood
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Heal additions are raw power: each +1 Heal power is +10 HP per tick of a static heal.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
